rationale: The agent canceled the order without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. It also did not demonstrate that the 4-foot variant was unavailable before proceeding to cancel, nor did it show a proper attempt to modify the order. Additionally, the statement that the refund was issued to a gift card balance appears unsupported by the provided tool calls/results. While the agent invoked some authentication- and order-related lookups, there’s no clear verification of order ownership or explicit authentication interaction. These issues fail the pass bar.
